title: DEN KO SENKA
description:
Defeat NODE-08 as quickly as possible and aim for the highest score!

Your energy gauge automatically recharges as you travel along power lines around the enemy and unleash electric attacks.

● ELECTRIC ATTACK 1: ELECTRIC ORBDeploy electric orbs along the power lines, then recall them at the perfect moment to deliver a blast of energy to any obstacle between you and the orb.

● ELECTRIC ATTACK 2: TELEPORTTeleport to a targeted utility pole in the distance.

Though this consumes a large amount of power, the teleport deals massive damage if the enemy is in your path.

● COMBOS FOR HEAVY DAMAGEChain your attacks together to build your combo and deliver extra damage.

● AVOID NODE-08'S OBSTACLESNODE-08 will send obstacles onto the power lines to block your path and disrupt your attacks.

NODE-08's attacks will stun you for a short time.

Do your best to avoid them and defeat the rogue Central Power Grid Controller as quickly as possible!

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

[NOTICE]

This game was created as part of Byking Inc.'s new employee training program. 

Depending on your PC environment, the game may not function properly or unexpected issues may occur. 

A keyboard & mouse or controller is required to play. 

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－
description_short: A high-speed boss action game where you ride power lines and unleash electric attacks. Take down the rogue Central Power Grid Controller, NODE-08!
